rationale: Both use the same pipeline: detector alignment, gradient x dmean, cross-probe sign signatures, minimal-pair probe queries, ablation. A groups latents by strict sign match plus flatness, adds a logit-gap/sum bound, and calls none from a neutral-text vs class-mean test. B uses cosine-signature assignment over a threshold grid, a true-logit ratio threshold, inspection exclusions and a large-set ceiling ablation.
